Package wellen

Class InstrumentMIDI

java.lang.Object
wellen.Instrument
wellen.InstrumentMIDI
public class InstrumentMIDI extends Instrument
instrument used by ToneEngineMIDI. the instrument ID is used as MIDI channel ( ID % 16 ).

the instrument keeps track of held notes. some parameters are mapped to standard MIDI control changes:

  • set_amplitude(float) → CC 7 ( volume ) with 0.0–1.0 mapped to 0–127
  • set_pan(float) → CC 10 ( pan ) with -1.0–1.0 mapped to 0–127
  • set_filter_frequency(float) → CC 74 ( cutoff ) with 20Hz–20kHz mapped logarithmically to 0–127
  • set_filter_resonance(float) → CC 71 ( resonance ) with 0.0–1.0 mapped to 0–127
  • pitch_bend(float) → pitch bend relative to the last played note, see set_pitch_bend_range(float)
all other parameters ( oscillator type, LFOs, envelopes etc. ) have no standard MIDI equivalent. their values are stored but not sent; a warning is printed once.

      public InstrumentMIDI(int pID)
      creates an instrument that only keeps track of its state. if it is used with ToneEngineMIDI.replace_instrument(Instrument) the engine connects it to its MIDI output.

      pID - instrument ID ( = MIDI channel )
